_description: Tracks whether stated confidence intervals contain actual price. Updated daily by grading loop.
calibration_notes: Target: 68% CI should capture ~68% of actual prices over rolling 20 days.
If realized_coverage > 0.85 for 68% bin: intervals too wide — tighten.
If realized_coverage < 0.50 for 68% bin: overconfident — widen by 25%.
